question: What Business Central AL guidance applies to handling failures and non-success responses from outbound HttpClient calls?
answer: When the Boolean result is false, stop without reading status, headers or content (microsoft/knowledge/web-services/handle-httpclient-platform-failure-before-response-access.md). Otherwise check IsSuccessStatusCode or the expected status before parsing the body as success data (microsoft/knowledge/web-services/check-http-status-before-consuming-response-body.md). The articles do not define a retry policy.
